notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
description:
Cast Welding Jar either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}
Showdown of the Skalds and Elsha's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve the Showdown of the Skalds trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Welding Jar from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.
